query_snapshot: Which alloy and heat-treatment conditions does NASA SP-8119 identify as susceptible to stress corrosion in its material-compatibility discussion?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 states that materials susceptible to stress corrosion include 2024-T3. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- NASA SP-8119 lists 17-7PH (annealed) among materials susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
